rationale: S-0024-03 proposes overlaying a Van Wart + Werginz AIS on the deRosenroll morphology (AIS-to-soma Na ratio ~7x, AIS length 25-50 um, two-subsegment proximal Nav1.2 / Nav1.1 plus distal Nav1.6 + Kv1.2) as a new library asset to test peak-rate recovery. This is folded into t0078 (bedb_mobo_v2_ais_tiered_ahp): t0078 builds the AIS section onto Bed B with the same Van Wart 2007 / Werginz 2020 priors, registers it as a new library asset (`de_rosenroll_2026_dsgc_ais` or similar), and uses it as the substrate for the bundled MOBO. Rejecting as covered by t0078.
